name: When is it necessary to relocate bathroom plumbing?

mainEntity.name: When is it necessary to relocate bathroom plumbing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Relocating bathroom plumbing is necessary when you are significantly changing your bathroom layout, such as moving a toilet, shower, or sink to a different wall or area of the room. This is common during full bathroom renovations, conversions of existing spaces into new bathrooms, or when expanding a bathroom. It's also required if you're addressing significant drainage issues that necessitate re-piping or if current pipework is incompatible with a desired new fixture type.
acceptedAnswer.description: It's necessary when significantly changing your bathroom layout, converting spaces, expanding a bathroom, or addressing major drainage issues.
